title: Somatosensory hand-velocity decoding
scientific_question: How accurately can the same frozen neural decoder reconstruct complete hand-velocity trajectories for active and perturbed trials in one held-trial session panel?
primary_outputs: Measured x/y hand-velocity trajectory in m/s:30 bins per query, all 92 queries.

data_manifest.prepared_split_warning: Train/test NWBs and MC_Maze Large/Medium/Small variants are derived releases of a source acquisition, not independent datasets.

recording_contract.neural: Actual NWB header confirms units/spike_times with ragged spike_times_index, heldout-unit flags and observation intervals;65units in the inspected training file. Unit labels are not persistent identities across other sessions.
recording_contract.labels: Actual training NWB contains826trial-table rows and columns bump_dir, bump_time, cond_dir, ctr_hold, ctr_hold_bump, go_cue_time, id, move_onset_time, result, split, start_time, stop_time, target_dir, target_on_time. Hand position/velocity are timestamped behavioral arrays. Additional labels must be masked when they are prediction targets.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Sorted spike timestamps and trial/event times are aligned in the NWB time base. Official NWBDataset bins spikes on a1ms grid and resamples for5ms/20ms benchmarks; MC_Maze behavior uses timestamps, Area2 uses starting_time/rate. Rate values and unit conversion still need acquisition qualification.

biological_ids.session_description: Data from monkey Han performing center-out active-passive task. This file contains several continuous segments of the full session on 2017-12-07 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.

recording_contract.evidence: Direct published asset URL inspected with bounded HTTP ranges; HDF5 names/shapes and identity metadata only, not neural/behavior values.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

primary.name: equal_condition_mean_variance_weighted_trajectory_R2
primary.aggregation: Within active/passive, pool 30 bins over all trials and combine axis SSE/SST; average the two condition R2 scores equally.
primary.rationale: Both conditions remain visible; variance-weighted two-axis R2 differs from 019 uniform-axis R2 and cannot be silently pooled with it.

secondary: Per-condition/per-axis R2 and squared Euclidean loss in(m/s)^2.
Condition/time-only, neural-shuffle and neural decoder signed differences are required proposed controls, not supplied competent baseline results.

comparators.name: condition_time_template
comparators.inputs: Training velocity, active/passive condition and relative time only.
comparators.procedure: Proposed training-only per-condition trajectory template frozen before query; essential nuisance comparator, currently not qualified by the deferred grader.

comparators.name: fixed_neural_decoder_and_shuffle
comparators.inputs: Same training observations and six-bin neural history.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed ridge/linear readout and same-condition whole-trial neural shuffle using identical fit/selection budget; qualify on actual packet before interpreting neural gain.

evaluation.failure_policy: Complete public validation before any private loader: exact ID coverage,30×2 finite nonboolean velocities and case hash. Preserve negative R2. Constant-target/numeric-range-undefined R2 remain null with squared loss retained; no subset score.
